contents: **Alternative state is isolated and answer reduction is output-aware.** Every disjunct candidate publishes a canonical response from isolated inference state. Aggregation is order-independent, retains hard knowledge common to every live alternative, and merges value-producing answers only when their outputs agree or an explicit priority rule dominates. Conjunct cancellation is permitted only after reconciling shared hard information. This is the solver consequence of [Versioned egraph children are inference transactions](../../../rfds/architectural-foundations/README.md#versioned-egraph-children-are-inference-transactions) and [Whiteboard producers own isolated proof contexts](../../../rfds/architectural-foundations/README.md#whiteboard-producers-own-isolated-proof-contexts).
